feed.title: awesome-free-ai-coding — what changed
feed.subtitle: Free LLM APIs and coding agents arriving, changing and dying, as the probes that run twice a week see it.

entry.title: Free models changed: AIHubMix (free models)
entry.summary: dropped gpt-oss · free models: glm-5.3, kimi-k3, glm-5, mimo-v2.5, north-mini-code

entry.title: Free models changed: Regolo AI
entry.summary: dropped llama-3.3 · free models: glm-5, gpt-oss, qwen3.8-27b, apertus-70b

entry.title: New: abliteration.ai
entry.summary: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API for three uncensored reasoning models, the large one derived from GLM-5.3, that opens with a one-credit free preview and no card

entry.title: New: Arli AI
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible inference on open models and their fine-tunes, whose Free plan tries each model five times every two days at 12K tokens of context, one request at a time

entry.title: New: Blue Claw Network
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes calls to a network of independent GPU operators running open models; every new account starts with a $5 welcome credit, and no card is asked to start

entry.title: New: Bytez
entry.summary: Serverless API over open models, whose Free plan grants $1 of credit every four weeks for open models of up to 7B parameters, one request at a time, with no billing

entry.title: New: Fireworks AI
entry.summary: Serverless inference on open-weight models — Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash among them — with a one-time $1 of credit that is spent without a card, at 10 requests a minute until a payment method is added

entry.title: Free models changed: Groq
entry.summary: added qwen3.8-27b; dropped qwen3.8 · free models: gpt-oss, qwen3.6, qwen3.8-27b

entry.title: Free models changed: Hetzner Inference API
entry.summary: added qwen3.8-27b; dropped qwen3.8 · free models: qwen3.6, qwen3.8-27b

entry.title: New: HPC-AI Model APIs
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible APIs over 24 models, GLM 5.3 Flash, Kimi K3 and MiniMax M3 among them, with $2 of free credit for every user — $4 with the vendor's invite code — at 5 requests a minute until a first deposit

entry.title: New: Impossibl
entry.summary: Prepaid gateway at provider list prices over 128 models, Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and GLM among them, whose keyless sign-up funds an account with $0.05 and adds $1 once a person claims it by email — no card

entry.title: New: LLM Tech
entry.summary: EU provider of one model, Qwen3.8 27B, whose quickstart prints a shared trial key for anyone: 2M tokens a day per address and 2 concurrent requests, tool calls included, no account · free models: qwen3.8-27b

entry.title: New: Mixlayer
entry.summary: Serverless open models priced per token, with one of them at $0 — Qwen3.5 4B as qwen/qwen3.5-4b-free, at 131K context — callable without prepaid credit · free models: qwen3.5-4b

entry.title: New: Moark (Gitee AI)
entry.summary: Gitee's model platform, formerly Gitee AI — 200+ open models behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs — whose free experience token gives every user 100 calls a day across its featured models, with nothing bought

entry.title: New: ModelScope API-Inference (Alibaba)
entry.summary: Alibaba's model community serves 35 models free — DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.2, MiniMax M3 and Qwen3.8 among them — for 250 魔粒 a day at 0.5 to 2 a call, after Alibaba Cloud real-name verification

entry.title: New: Opper
entry.summary: EU-hosted gateway over 700+ models whose free models — Gemma 4 31B and Gemma 4 26B on Google's route, Laguna S 2.1 and XS 2.1 through Poolside — answer an account with no card on file; every other model needs a card and credits · free models: gemma-4-31b

entry.title: Free models changed: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
entry.summary: added qwen3.8-27b; dropped qwen3.8 · free models: gpt-oss, qwen3.6, qwen3.8-27b, qwen3-coder

entry.title: Free models changed: Regolo AI
entry.summary: added qwen3.8-27b; dropped qwen3.8 · free models: glm-5, gpt-oss, qwen3.8-27b, llama-3.3, apertus-70b

entry.title: Free models changed: Requesty
entry.summary: added muse-glimmer-30b, nemotron-3.5-lightning · free models: nemotron-3-ultra, nemotron-3-super, gemma-4, ling-3.0-tiny, muse-glimmer-30b, nemotron-3.5-lightning

entry.title: New: SiliconFlow (China)
entry.summary: China's SiliconFlow prices eight small chat models at ¥0 — Qwen3-8B, GLM-4-9B-0414 and the 29B Xing4.0 among them — for an account verified with Chinese, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan papers · free models: xing4.0-29b, qwen3-8b, glm-4-9b-0414

entry.title: New: Tencent Cloud TokenHub
entry.summary: Tencent Cloud's model platform — Hy3, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and MiniMax-M3 among its models — with a one-time grant of a million tokens on its language models, valid a year and no card, on an account that has passed Tencent Cloud real-name verification

entry.title: New: The Grid
entry.summary: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference market that sells quality tiers rather than model names — Agent Max was served by Claude Opus 5 in the 30 days to 2026-09-03 — with a $25 signup credit, for a limited time

entry.title: Free models changed: Token Harbor
entry.summary: added deepseek-v4-flash · free models: deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-flash, mimo-v2.5

entry.title: Free models changed: Vercel AI Gateway
entry.summary: added ling-3.0-flash-fin, ling-3.0-flash-sante · free models: laguna-s-2.1, ling-3.0-flash-fin, ling-3.0-flash-sante

entry.title: New: VLM Run Gateway
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible gateway for vision and language models whose models on VLM Run's own GPUs, Qwen3.8 27B among them, answer anonymous callers — no signup, no key — at 100 requests a day per IP, in alpha · free models: qwen3.8-27b

entry.title: Free models changed: AIHubMix (free models)
entry.summary: added glm-5.3, kimi-k3 · free models: glm-5.3, kimi-k3, glm-5, mimo-v2.5, north-mini-code, gpt-oss

entry.title: New: Amazon Q Developer
entry.summary: AWS's coding assistant in the IDE and the CLI; its perpetual Free Tier gives a Builder ID user 50 agentic requests a month

entry.title: Delisted: Cerebras Inference
entry.summary: its only free offer was $5 of credit granted after a verified payment method is added, expiring in 30 days — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit

entry.title: Free models changed: Cline
entry.summary: dropped deepseek-v4-flash · free models: laguna-s-2.1

entry.title: Free models changed: Freebuff
entry.summary: added deepseek-v4.1-flash; dropped deepseek-v4-flash · free models: glm-5.3-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, gpt-5.6-luna, mimo-v2.5

entry.title: Delisted: Infomaniak AI Services
entry.summary: a one-month wallet of a million credits, and "A credit card is required to start using the API" — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit

entry.title: Delisted: Kenari
entry.summary: rejected for cause — the operator's own JavaScript bundle showed its capacity coming from pooled ChatGPT and Codex OAuth credentials, captcha solvers and a proxy pool that multiplies per-IP free quotas

entry.title: New: LLM7.io
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible API with an anonymous tier — no account, no key — of 500,000 tokens a day on its turbo models, GLM 5.3 Flash, MiniMax M2.7 and Codestral among them; a free token doubles it

entry.title: New: Nous Portal (Hermes Agent)
entry.summary: Nous Research's inference portal behind its Hermes Agent: a $0 Free plan limited to the models it prices at zero — eight on 2026-09-16, Step 3.7 Flash and Laguna S 2.1 among them — on an OpenAI-compatible API · free models: step-3.7-flash, laguna-s-2.1

entry.title: Free models changed: opencode
entry.summary: added muse-spark-1.3-contributor; dropped muse-spark-1.2 · free models: big-pickle, mimo-v2.5, ling-3.0-flash-fin, nemotron-3-ultra, nemotron-3.5-lightning, muse-spark-1.3-contributor

entry.title: New: Token Harbor
entry.summary: OpenAI-compatible gateway with a $0 plan: explicit :free ids for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo V2.5 on a value-based allowance, no card · free models: deepseek-v4.1-flash, mimo-v2.5

entry.title: Free models changed: Yolo-Auto
entry.summary: added qwen3.8-flash; dropped qwen3.8 · free models: qwen3.8-flash

entry.title: New: Zed
entry.summary: Open-source code editor with a hosted AI agent: a 14-day Pro trial with $5 of GPT-5.6 Luna and unlimited edit predictions, no card, then 2,000 accepted edit predictions on the $0 Personal plan · free models: gpt-5.6-luna

entry.title: New: Agnes AI
entry.summary: Agnes AI's own models behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with its Flash text models charged at zero today and image generation free beside them · free models: agnes-3.0-flash, agnes-2.5-flash

entry.title: New: Cline
entry.summary: Open-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal; signing in to its own Cline provider unlocks a rotating set of free models, each with a daily allowance, beside pay-as-you-go credits, the $9.99 ClinePass plan and BYOK · free models: deepseek-v4-flash, laguna-s-2.1

entry.title: New: JetBrains AI (AI Free)
entry.summary: AI Free in JetBrains IDEs — unlimited code completion on JetBrains' Mellum model and 3 AI Credits ($3) of cloud models every 30 days for chat and agents
